title: How I Make My Daily Salad: 700 Calories, $4 a Bowl, Fresh for 7 Days
hook: This salad is how I break my fast almost every day, and it's my most important nutrition habit.
body: I used to pay $20 a day at the Whole Foods salad bar. Now I make a week of them in one go for about $4 a bowl, and they stay fresh for 7 days. Here's the exact build: arugula, carrots, grape tomatoes, broccolini, English cucumber and red onion, rotisserie chicken and eggs, olives and pico, and an olive oil dressing you mix right in the bowl.
close: Save this for your next meal prep day.
youtube_description:
This is the salad I eat almost every day to stay lean: about 700 calories, about $4 a bowl, and it stays fresh for 7 days in the fridge.

See what you'd look like with a six-pack, free:
https://absbyai.com/?utm_source=youtube&utm_medium=video&utm_campaign=longform&utm_content=ro05-daily-salad

The daily salad is my number one nutrition habit. It is filling, high in protein, easy to track, and it costs a fraction of a salad bar bowl ($20 at the salad bar vs about $4 made at home). In this video I show you the four parts of the perfect daily salad, how I build it, how I keep a week of salads fresh for 7 days, and how I add the protein and toppings. At the end I track the finished bowl with the Abs By AI app: it estimated 683 calories against about 720 when I weighed everything by hand.

Make it your own: if you don't like chicken, use another protein. If you don't like arugula, use other greens. The structure is what matters.
